intended_regime: REMOTE_GPU(res, rr CLI, one task per GPU)

deviation.reason: SSH to the research host failed continuously from T0 with transport-level errors (see evidence); the rr CLI could not reach the box, so the frozen round was executed on the local host instead of the two remote GPUs.
evidence: rr doctor res -> 'Connection timed out during banner exchange' (proxied through pve-old.yulinsec.cn:22)
repeated ssh probes every 45 s from T0 to the launch of Stage B: 'ssh: connect to host pve-old.yulinsec.cn port 22: Connection timed out'
local egress verified healthy (ICMP and HTTPS to unrelated hosts succeed)
impact: No remote GPU provenance (driver/node) is available for this round; the execution regime is recorded as LOCAL_CPU.
Wall-clock budget was preserved by running two workers of 7 torch threads each on the local host, mirroring the one-task-per-GPU concurrency of the original plan.
All arms share the same regime, so cross-arm condition differences remain internally comparable; absolute numbers are not comparable to the round-1 GPU numbers.

notes: wp_run.py records commit, device name, torch version and wall seconds in every run.json.
analyse.py output (analysis/summary.json) carries the same commit and the config sha256.
